title: In Wang Yorwa
stanzas: In wang`yorwa; wabironi Kwaringo keth gi tho;Kendo ng`a modwaro wuoro Nyak` odware kuomi.
In Adiera; Wachni kende Nyalo miwa rieko;Puonj madieri oa kuomi, In ma Japwodh chunywa.
In ngimawa; liel ma notur Ohulo tekoni;Tho kata liel ok anonyal Jogo magenoi.
In yo, Adiera, gi Ngima; Puonjwa wang`e yorno;Konywa warit adierano, Miwa ngimani, Ruoth.
